name: Michelle May O'Neil
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Frisco, Texas
about: Michelle May O'Neil has been Board Certified in Family Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization since 1997. She is the founder of Concierra Legal in Frisco, where her practice is built around three areas: family law appeals, prenuptial and marital agreement strategy, and strategic counsel for clients whose matters are too complex or too consequential to be handled routinely.

Michelle has 34 years of experience. She has tried more than 37 jury trials and handled 195+ appellate matters across the Texas Courts of Appeals, including 55 matters before the Texas Supreme Court. She has also applied for review before the United States Supreme Court.

Michelle calls her method appellate-first. Rather than waiting until a case reaches an appeals court, she considers from the beginning how decisions made during litigation will hold up under later review. At trial, as she describes it, the legal team is building two things at once: the case the judge or jury will decide, and the record an appellate court may someday read.

She is an accredited continuing legal education sponsor with the State Bar of Texas and has authored and presented more than 60 accredited CLE courses. She founded and taught the Family Law Trial Skills Bootcamp at Baylor University School of Law and is a recurring guest editor of the case digests for the State Bar of Texas Family Law Section Report. She writes and speaks nationally on artificial intelligence, identity rights, and the future of legal practice including at the prestigious SXSW conference in 2026, and hosts The Michelle May O'Neil Show, nominated for a Webby Award in 2026.

Michelle earned a B.B.A. from Baylor University's Hankamer School of Business in 1989 and her J.D. from Baylor University School of Law in 1991. She holds a post-doctoral certification in Women's Leadership from Harvard Law School, and is a certified arbitrator through the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers and a certified mediator through Texas Woman's University.

Best Lawyers in America* has recognized her in both Family Law and Appellate Practice for twelve consecutive years. She has been named among the Top 50 Texas Women Super Lawyers* in Texas for thirteen consecutive years and to the Top 100 Dallas/Fort Worth Super Lawyres, and was listed among Forbes Advisor's Top 10 Divorce Lawyers in Dallas. D Magazine has repeatedly recognized her in D's Best of Dallas, Women of Influence and Leaders in Law, and she appears in Who's Who in American Law as well as other Who's Who publications. She holds AV Preeminent* and Judicial AV Preeminent* peer review ratings from Martindale-Hubbell. In 2024, Michelle was named a finalist to Success Magazine's nationally recognized Women of Influence List.

In 2026 Michelle spoke at SXSW on identity ownership in the AI era, where she introduced the Identity Stack™ — a seven-layer model of how identity fragments across biological, legal, economic, representational, algorithmic, synthetic, and agentic layers. The framework is now taught in the curriculum at the Stanford Graduate School of Business. Her talk was covered by Texas Lawyer, Mashable, and the State Bar of Texas Bar Journal.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards. Best Lawyers in America is owned by BL Rankings.
